Plot metric sensitivity across tuning-grid parameters

Source: R/nll_sensitivity.R
plot_nll_sensitivity.Rd

Plot metric sensitivity across tuning-grid parameters

Usage

plot_nll_sensitivity(
  x,
  metric = "bernoulli_nll",
  parameters = NULL,
  run = NULL,
  season = NULL,
  statistic = c("best_metric", "mean_metric", "adjacent_gain"),
  facet_scales = "free_x"
)

Arguments

x

A tuning result, a named tuning-result list, or a page_nll_sensitivity object from extract_nll_sensitivity().

metric

Metric column when x is a raw tuning result.

parameters

Optional parameters to plot.

run

Optional run names to retain.

season

Optional season. When supplied, plots season-specific values from by_season; otherwise plots overall values.

statistic

Either "best_metric" (default), "mean_metric", or "adjacent_gain".

facet_scales

Passed to ggplot2::facet_wrap().

Value

A ggplot object.
